sentences.text: Cooper is on day 46 of 56 of an owner-entered Royal Canin HP trial (hydrolysed soy), but chicken has been in his diet since Jun 8: Dentastix, whose label lists chicken, are on the owner's allowed list and fed daily, with at least 4 off-list feedings on top, the last on Jun 27.
Itching was logged on 16 of 43 logged days over at least 35 days, and this record is not a test of the diet: Apoquel, NexGard from Jun 5 and the Dentastix from Jun 8 all overlap the trial.
Apoquel 16 mg once daily was prescribed Apr 30, but no doses logged appear in the record, so whether it was given is unknown.
The owner wrote "flare after the chicken on Sunday" on Jun 18; that link was not tested, as chicken was fed daily from Jun 8.
On the home scale he went from 32.4 kg on May 18 to 31.8 kg on Jun 29 across 3 readings.
